title: KeyTransitionRecord
description: Append-only log record written on AWS KMS key rotation. Signed by the NEW key. Historical entries remain immutable; new key signs forward only. Follows Sigstore Rekor / RFC 9162 Certificate Transparency forward-only signing pattern. v0.1-DRAFT.

entry_type.description: Discriminator field. Must be exactly 'key_transition' to distinguish from AuditLogEntry records in the same append-only log.

transition_id.description: UUID v4. Unique identifier for this transition event.

transitioned_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp when the new key became the active signing key.

prev_key_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 hex fingerprint of the retiring key's public key material.

new_key_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 hex fingerprint of the new key's public key material.

transition_signature.description: Base64-encoded signature over the canonical JSON of this record (excluding the transition_signature field itself), produced by the NEW key. Verifier uses new_key_fingerprint to resolve the public key from AWS KMS.

prev_key_archived_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp when the retiring key's public key material was written to the archive_location. The retiring key is not destroyed — it is archived to enable verification of historical entries.

customer_id.description: Customer namespace this key transition applies to. Used as the partition prefix in the R2 archive path and the KV index.

archive_location.description: R2 URI where the retiring key's public key material is durably stored. Format: r2://<bucket>/<path>. In v0.1, the customer pulls from this dead-letter bucket. Webhook delivery is deferred to v0.2.

signing_key_version.description: AWS KMS key version ID of the NEW key used to produce transition_signature. This is the key version that will sign all subsequent AuditLogEntry records.

transition_justification.description: Optional free-text reason for rotation (e.g. scheduled rotation, incident response, policy requirement). Not required — rotation can be unilateral.

x-immutability-note: Historical AuditLogEntry records are NOT re-signed on key rotation. The audit verifier walks the key-transition chain forward: for each entry, resolve signing_key_version to the active key at that timestamp via the ordered sequence of KeyTransitionRecord events in the same log.
